##### Project general facts

Il Teatro Residences 1 and 2 by Arada is a pair of identical mid-rise residential buildings overlooking one of the signature landmarks of the community, a theatre designed by the renowned Japanese architect Tadao Ando, and its multi-level pedestrian plaza. Each building rises above a basement parking level and a ground floor to seven residential floors, crowned by a rooftop infinity pool and lounge. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with two- and three-bedroom lofts.

Residents enjoy a gym, a private health club and a landscaped park with recreation areas, while a green corridor leads directly to the theatre and its cultural venues. The neighbourhood includes an auditorium, a gallery, an outdoor plaza with an amphitheatre above a reflective water feature, and green spines with tree canopies, artist studios, workshops and cafes. Concierge services, laundry, round-the-clock security and children's play areas complete the shared offer.

Interiors combine vibrant colours with high-quality fixtures and premium materials, and every home features integrated smart home technology. Duplex lofts showcase double-height living and dining areas framed by full-glass curtain walls, while terraces extend the living space outdoors with views of the theatre and plaza. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fully equipped kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, retail, hospitality, education and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with parks, a skate park, a drive-in cinema and a wide choice of restaurants, while the theatre district adds a vibrant cultural dimension to daily life.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. City Centre Al Zahia is close by, University City and Madar are a short drive away, and Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach. Showrooms, supermarkets, cafes and restaurants sit within walking distance.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most ambitious mixed-use developments in Sharjah. A cultural landmark on the doorstep, integrated retail and leisure and strong road links to Dubai attract families, students and young professionals. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
